exit 0
--- stdout
Budget tool results and retrieve sanitized artifacts
Usage:
liza tool-result [command]
Available Commands:
acp-proxy Budget native ACP host responses before agent context
claude-hook Apply native Claude post tool-result hooks
codex-hook Apply the managed Codex tool-result boundary
filter Read a complete tool result from stdin
read Read a bounded byte range from a sanitized artifact
run Capture a command before native truncation or streaming
stats Report persisted tool-result budget telemetry as JSON
Flags:
--digest-bytes int Maximum externalized result digest bytes (default 4096)
-h, --help help for tool-result
--root string Artifact directory (default: project state directory/tool-results)
--threshold-bytes int Externalize results larger than this many bytes (default 32768)
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
Use "liza tool-result [command] --help" for more information about a command.
--- stderr
